# tiny-mcp-skel

Stdlib-only MCP (Model Context Protocol) server skeleton. ~150 LOC of executable code combining tiny-router blueprints + tiny-validator McpServer schema. Zero external runtime dependencies (just tiny-router + tiny-validator).

## Run

```bash
pip install tiny-router tiny-validator
python examples/echo_server.py
```

## API

```python
from tiny_mcp_skel import make_server, run_stdio
from tiny_validator import Schema, String

server = make_server(name="my-mcp", version="0.1.0")

@server.tool(
    name="echo",
    description="Echo the input.",
    input_schema=Schema({"text": String()}),
)
def echo_handler(params):
    return {"content": [{"type": "text", "text": params["text"]}]}

run_stdio(server)
```

## Features

- JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio (the default MCP transport)
- HTTP transport via `server.as_router()`
- Eager manifest validation: tool registrations run `validate_mcp_manifest` on every add
- Standard MCP methods: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `ping`
- Integrates with `tiny-router-sse` for SSE-aware OpenAPI export
